## Change Type

- [ ] Add one resource.
- [ ] Update, move, replace, or remove an existing entry.
- [ ] Improve project infrastructure or documentation.

## Resource

[Canonical resource name](https://example.com/)

## Relevance and Intended Users

Explain the direct Kyoto Animation connection, who the resource helps, and the need it serves.

## Language, Source Type, and Access

List the resource/interface languages, identify its source type, and disclose any login, payment, regional, software, or other access limitations.

## Distinct Value

Explain what this adds beyond existing entries. For an update, explain what changed and why the proposed result is better.

## Affiliation

State whether you maintain, contribute to, publish, or are otherwise affiliated with the resource. Write “None” when not applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `EDITORIAL.md`.
- [ ] The resource is directly relevant to Kyoto Animation and belongs in the proposed section.
- [ ] I inspected the resource and used its canonical HTTPS URL.
- [ ] The description is factual, concise, in English, starts with an uppercase character, and ends with a period.
- [ ] The entry is unique, correctly placed, and alphabetized.
- [ ] The resource does not primarily redistribute unauthorized copyrighted material.
- [ ] My submitted catalog text may be distributed under this repository's CC0 license.
- [ ] I ran `make check` and, when Lychee is installed, `make links`.
